title: The AI Flywheel
description: An infographic MicroSim of the AI Flywheel causal loop.
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the four components of the AI flywheel: Data, Model, Prediction, and Feedback
Trace the causal loop in which data creates a model, the model creates predictions, predictions generate feedback, and feedback provides more data
Explain why the AI flywheel is a self-reinforcing cycle in which each pass through the loop improves the system
Describe the function of each component by hovering over its node and reading the infobox description
Predict how weakening one link, such as losing user feedback, would slow the entire flywheel
